posts.title: It's harder to get all Bs than all As and one F
posts.description: I hit a point in school where even my best efforts couldn't get me all As any more, and that led to the difficult but useful lesson in how to get all Bs. When you're getting all As, you don't need to ask if you're working too hard on something or guess when you're "done". posts.title: Peak dining experience
posts.description: A few years ago I was in Baltimore for a wedding. Beforehand a bunch of the attendees met up to tour the guinness brewery. When we got there the brewery wasn't taking walk-ins for the tour (because covid). They said we could sit in the garden outside and order beer and stuff though. posts.title: Just showing up to No Kings
posts.description: Yesterday my mom mentioned that there were No Kings protests happening this weekend. That was the first I'd heard of it, and I saw that there was a big gathering in a local park later that day. As I walked up, I wondered what I'd say if confronted by a counter-protestor. It's so easy to get lost in the haze of outrage that one doesn't have an answer for the basic question of "but what specifically
